summary: Wellchange Holdings, a Hong Kong-based software services company, filed a Form 6-K reporting shareholder approvals for a reverse stock split. At a September 2, 2026 Class B meeting and EGM, shareholders approved consolidating every five Class A ordinary shares into one, reducing outstanding shares from 52,905,328 to approximately 10,581,066. Fractional shares will be rounded up, and the split takes effect September 8, 2026 on Nasdaq under symbol WCT with a new CUSIP. This routine corporate action does not constitute a special situation, as it is a standard capital adjustment with no M&A, tender, or restructuring implications.
